intro: Pets Eden is searching for dedicated and passionate individuals who love animals as much as we do. For those that thrive in a work environment that revolves around the care of our furry friends, being a part of our dynamic team is a start to an extremely rewarding career. While some experience is preferred, we welcome anyone from any background to apply for the various positions available below, so long as you are willing to make animals a part of your everyday work life.

jobs.title: Customer Service Associate (Full-Time)
jobs.intro: We're looking for a friendly, animal-loving customer service associate to be the welcoming face of our grooming shop!
duties: Greet clients and their pets, checking them in/out for appointments
Answer phone calls, emails, and messages professionally and warmly
Handle payments and basic point-of-sale tasks
Address client questions or concerns with patience and care
Help keep the front desk and waiting area clean and welcoming
Assist groomers with light pet handling as needed (leashing, calming nervous pets, etc.)
requirements: Excellent verbal communication skills — comfortable talking with a wide range of people
Genuine love for animals and comfort being around dogs/cats of all sizes and temperaments
Friendly, patient, and calm under pressure
Strong organizational skills (juggling a schedule, phones, and walk-ins)
Prior customer service or retail experience a plus

jobs.title: Pet Transport Driver (Independent Contractor)
jobs.intro: We're looking for a responsible, animal-loving independent driver with their own vehicle to safely transport pets between clients' homes and our grooming shop on a contract basis.
duties: Pick up pets from clients' homes and bring them to the shop for grooming appointments
Safely secure pets during transport (in travel crates)
Return pets home after grooming is complete
Communicate with clients about pickup/drop-off times and any delays
Handle pets calmly and confidently, including nervous or anxious animals
Keep your vehicle clean, sanitized, and pet-safe between trips
Follow a daily pickup/drop-off schedule and plan your route efficiently
requirements: Must own a reliable vehicle suitable for pet transport (clean, well-maintained, adequate space for crates/carriers)
Valid driver's license with a clean driving record
Comfortable handling dogs/cats of all sizes and temperaments
Good communication skills for coordinating with clients and shop staff
Ability to lift/carry pets and pet carriers as needed
extra: This is an independent contractor position (not an employee role)
Pay per trip/route (rate to be discussed)
Driver responsible for own vehicle maintenance, fuel, and insurance

footnote: If you are interested in applying for any of the above positions, please email your resume, portfolio & asking salary to charlwong@gmail.com.
